title: Edward Wotton (Scotland) to Walsingham, drafts of 25 Aug, 30 Aug and 1 Sep 1585 (DECODE R4841-R4843)

steps.what: Fetched the twelve DECODE images of R4841-R4843 with the stored cookie.
Recognised the pages as Wotton's own clear-English drafts headed 'To Mr Secretary', with code numbers only for names; no letter cipher.
Identified the code numbers from context: 19 Arran, 39 Master of Gray, 10 King James (certain); 9 Elizabeth/England, 20 Maxwell, 24 Huntly, 3 France (probable).
Tried to check CSP Scotland vol. 8 for the calendared despatches and their resolved names; BHO paywalled, archive.org copy lending-only.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): the name-code table copied verbatim from NOTES.md to texts/key.md and a summary given for each draft. Missing: the three drafts (clear English with name numbers) were never transcribed into the folder, so no transcription or glossed text exists

validation.notes: clear drafts with a few name-code numbers; no ciphertext transcription in the folder

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The three drafts are in clear English with a small numeric name code; the code numbers (19 Arran, 39 Master of Gray, 10 King James and others) were identified from the clear text around them, and later checked against CSP Scotland viii, which glosses several of them.
outcome.notes: Drafts read in full; 7 of 11 code numbers identified (3 certain, 4 probable), 27, 32, 36, 40 open.

credits.note: CSP Scotland viii glosses fixed 24 Farnyhurst and 40 Justice Clerk (checked after the reading)

texts.label: R4841, Add MS 32657 ff. 167-168, Wotton to Walsingham, 25 Aug 1585 (draft)
texts.summary: Gray [39] urges that while Arran [19] is in favour with the King [10] the banished lords can never be restored nor a league with England made safe, and proposes that Elizabeth fund the lords to take Arran and seize the King's person; rumours that Arran and Ferniehirst [24] are agreed and that 24 may carry the King to France.

texts.label: R4842, Add MS 32657 ff. 173-174, 30 Aug 1585 (draft)
texts.summary: Answers Walsingham's letter of the 21st about Gray's complaint; 27 and 40; Arran still at Kinneil under guard; Bothwell come to court 'to the great grief of the Arranistes'; the Jesuits Hay and Dury in the country.

texts.label: R4843, Add MS 32657 ff. 175-176, 1 Sep 1585 (draft)
texts.summary: The device of Gray and the Prior of Blantyre: the lords to join with Maxwell [20] under colour of his feud and send 500 men to seize the King and Arran, the plan that became the lords' return and Arran's fall at Stirling in November 1585.

prior.where: CSP Scotland vol. 8 (1914) calendars Wotton's despatches of these dates and glosses four of the code numbers (19 Arran, 39 Gray, 40 Justice Clerk, 24 Farnyhurst); consulted after the reading via HathiTrust. DECODE lists the records as Non-decrypted.
